form.label: OCP Enterprise Incident, API & Kafka Investigation Center v7.1
form.description: Enterprise-ready, multi-application OCP triage dashboard for L1/L2. Correlates pod/container evidence, REST API failures, Kafka/chunk processing, downstream writes, blast radius, ingestion health, and escalation guidance.

input.label: What do you want to investigate?

html.div:
Active scope: $selected_app_label$ | Index: $selected_index$ | Project: $selected_project$ | Data center: $datacenter$
L1 flow: identify impact → capture correlation/chunk ID → follow the end-to-end journey → verify recovery → export the escalation package when required.

html.p: One-screen assessment of current actionable conditions. Red means immediate investigation; amber means degraded or delayed processing.

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_summary$ | where gate=1 | search (ERROR OR FATAL OR Exception OR CrashLoopBackOff OR OOMKilled OR "ImagePullBackOff" OR "status=FAILED" OR "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE") | stats count

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_summary$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), s=coalesce(statusCode,status_code,http_status,httpStatus,responseCode,'message.statusCode','message.httpStatus') | rex field=txt "(?<s2>4[0-9]{2}|5[0-9]{2})" | eval code=coalesce(s,s2) | where tonumber(code)>=400 | stats count

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_summary$ | where gate=1 | search (kafka OR consumer OR producer OR topic OR partition OR offset OR deserializ* OR "message processing") (ERROR OR Exception OR failed OR timeout OR stuck OR rebalance) | stats count

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_summary$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host) | stats dc(pod)

table.title: Immediate Error Triage — newest evidence first

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_summary$ | where gate=1 | search (ERROR OR FATAL OR Exception OR CrashLoopBackOff OR OOMKilled OR "ImagePullBackOff" OR "status=FAILED" OR timeout OR "connection refused" OR kafka OR "REST_API_CALL_ERROR") | spath | eval pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown"), container=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name',container_name,"Unknown"), text=coalesce(message,body,_raw) | eval category=case(match(text,"(?i)CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|ImagePullBackOff"),"POD / PLATFORM",match(text,"(?i)kafka|consumer|producer|deserializ|partition|offset"),"KAFKA / MESSAGING",match(text,"(?i)REST_API_CALL_ERROR|HTTP|status.?code"),"REST API",match(text,"(?i)SQL|database|JDBC|deadlock"),"DATABASE",true(),"APPLICATION") | table _time category pod container text | sort 0 -_time | head 300

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$view_gate_summary$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown"), endpoint=coalesce(URL,url,uri,path,endpoint,route,"Not logged"), topic=coalesce(topic,topicName,kafka_topic,"Not logged") | rex field=txt "(?i)(?<http_code>4[0-9]{2}|5[0-9]{2})" | eval category=case(match(txt,"(?i)CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|ImagePullBackOff|readiness probe|liveness probe"),"OCP / PLATFORM",match(txt,"(?i)kafka|consumer|producer|partition|offset|rebalance|DLQ"),"KAFKA / MESSAGING",match(txt,"(?i)database|JDBC|SQL|deadlock|connection pool"),"DATABASE",match(txt,"(?i)NAS|file share|permission denied|file not found"),"NAS / STORAGE",match(txt,"(?i)401|403|token|authentication|authorization"),"AUTHENTICATION",match(txt,"(?i)HTTP|REST_API|status.?code"),"REST API",true(),"APPLICATION") | search (ERROR OR FATAL OR Exception OR failed OR timeout OR CrashLoopBackOff OR OOMKilled OR http_code=*) | stats earliest(_time) as First_Seen latest(_time) as Last_Seen count as Events dc(pod) as Affected_Pods values(pod) as Pods dc(endpoint) as Endpoints dc(topic) as Topics by category dc | eval Scope=case(Affected_Pods=1,"ISOLATED — one pod",Affected_Pods<=3,"LOCALIZED — several pods",Affected_Pods>3,"WIDESPREAD — many pods",true(),"UNKNOWN"), Likely_Owner=case(category="OCP / PLATFORM","OCP Platform",category="KAFKA / MESSAGING","Kafka / Messaging",category="DATABASE","Database / Application",category="NAS / STORAGE","Storage / Application",category="AUTHENTICATION","Identity / Application",category="REST API","Application / Upstream",true(),"Application L2") | convert ctime(First_Seen) ctime(Last_Seen) | sort -Events

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$view_gate_summary$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown"), ingest_delay=_indextime-_time | stats latest(_time) as Last_Event latest(_indextime) as Last_Indexed avg(ingest_delay) as Avg_Ingest_Delay_Sec max(ingest_delay) as Max_Ingest_Delay_Sec count as Events by pod dc | eval Seconds_Since_Last_Event=now()-Last_Event, Log_State=case(Seconds_Since_Last_Event>1800,"RED — No recent logs",Seconds_Since_Last_Event>600,"AMBER — Logs stale",Max_Ingest_Delay_Sec>300,"AMBER — Indexing delayed",true(),"GREEN — Current") | convert ctime(Last_Event) ctime(Last_Indexed) | sort Log_State -Seconds_Since_Last_Event

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | eval gate=$view_gate_summary$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown"), container=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name',container_name,"Unknown"), correlation=coalesce(correlationId,correlation_id,traceId,trace_id,requestId,request_id,"Not logged"), chunk=coalesce(chunkId,chunk_id,batchId,batch_id,"Not logged"), endpoint=coalesce(URL,url,uri,path,endpoint,route,"Not logged"), topic=coalesce(topic,topicName,kafka_topic,"Not logged") | search (ERROR OR FATAL OR Exception OR failed OR timeout OR CrashLoopBackOff OR OOMKilled OR DLQ OR dead-letter) | eval Signature=replace(txt,"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F-]{27,}","<ID>"), Signature=replace(Signature,"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}[T ][0-9:.Z+-]+","<TIME>"), Finding=case(match(txt,"(?i)CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|ImagePullBackOff"),"Pod/platform failure",match(txt,"(?i)consumer.?lag|rebalance|DLQ|dead-letter"),"Kafka processing issue",match(txt,"(?i)401|403|token|auth"),"Authentication/API issue",match(txt,"(?i)database|JDBC|SQL|deadlock"),"Database issue",match(txt,"(?i)NAS|permission denied|file not found"),"Storage issue",true(),"Application error"), L1_Action=case(Finding="Pod/platform failure","Capture pod/container/restart evidence; verify OCP state; use approved restart runbook only",Finding="Kafka processing issue","Check consumer pod, topic, lag trend, retry/DLQ and chunk timeline",Finding="Authentication/API issue","Validate status code, endpoint, service account/token timing and correlation ID",Finding="Database issue","Check whether multiple pods are affected; capture timeout/deadlock evidence; escalate",Finding="Storage issue","Verify destination/path evidence and whether writes recovered; escalate to storage/application",true(),"Capture correlation/chunk ID, first/last occurrence and export evidence") | stats earliest(_time) as First_Seen latest(_time) as Last_Seen count as Occurrences values(pod) as Pods values(container) as Containers values(endpoint) as Endpoints values(topic) as Topics values(correlation) as Correlation_ID values(chunk) as Chunk_ID latest(L1_Action) as Recommended_Action by Finding Signature dc | convert ctime(First_Seen) ctime(Last_Seen) | sort -Occurrences | head 200

html.p: Log-derived workload view. A stale timestamp means Splunk has not recently received matching logs; confirm actual runtime state in OCP before restarting anything.

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_pods$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host,"Unknown"), container=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name',container_name,"Unknown"), txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pf=lower("$pod_filter$") | where pf="*" OR like(lower(pod),"%".pf."%") OR like(lower(container),"%".pf."%") | eval critical=if(match(txt,"(?i)CrashLoopBackOff|OOMKilled|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull|Evicted|OutOfMemory|FATAL"),1,0), error=if(match(txt,"(?i)ERROR|Exception|failed|timeout"),1,0) | stats latest(_time) as Last_Seen sum(critical) as Critical_Events sum(error) as Error_Events count as Log_Events by pod container | eval Minutes_Since_Last_Log=round((now()-Last_Seen)/60,1), State=case(Critical_Events>0,"RED — Critical",Error_Events>0,"AMBER — Errors",Minutes_Since_Last_Log>15,"AMBER — Stale logs",true(),"GREEN — Reporting") | convert ctime(Last_Seen) | sort State -Error_Events

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") (CrashLoopBackOff OR OOMKilled OR ImagePullBackOff OR ErrImagePull OR Evicted OR "Readiness probe failed" OR "Liveness probe failed" OR "Back-off restarting") | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_pods$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host), container=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name',container_name), Evidence=coalesce(message,_raw), pf=lower("$pod_filter$") | where pf="*" OR like(lower(pod),"%".pf."%") | table _time pod container Evidence | sort 0 -_time | head 1000

html.p: Failures, endpoint trends, latency evidence, correlation IDs, and exportable raw events. Query-string values are redacted in the displayed endpoint.

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_api$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), ep=coalesce(URL,url,uri,path,request_uri,requestPath,endpoint,route,'message.URL','message.url','message.uri','message.path','message.endpoint') | rex field=txt "(?i)(?<ep2>https?://[^\s\"']+|/(?:api|rest|v[0-9])[^\s\"']+)" | eval ep=coalesce(ep,ep2) | where isnotnull(ep) | eval ep=replace(ep,"\\?.*$","?[REDACTED]") | stats count by ep | sort -count | head 100

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_api$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host), ep=coalesce(URL,url,uri,path,request_uri,requestPath,endpoint,route,'message.URL','message.url','message.uri','message.path','message.endpoint'), code=coalesce(statusCode,status_code,http_status,httpStatus,responseCode,'message.statusCode','message.httpStatus'), latency=coalesce(duration,responseTime,response_time,elapsed,latency,'message.duration','message.responseTime') | rex field=txt "(?i)(?<code2>4[0-9]{2}|5[0-9]{2})" | rex field=txt "(?i)(?<ep2>https?://[^\s\"']+|/(?:api|rest|v[0-9])[^\s\"']+)" | eval code=coalesce(code,code2), ep=coalesce(ep,ep2,"Endpoint not logged"), ep=replace(ep,"\\?.*$","?[REDACTED]"), endpoint_filter="$api_endpoint$" | where tonumber(code)>=400 AND (endpoint_filter="*" OR ep=endpoint_filter) | stats count as Failures avg(latency) as Avg_Latency_ms max(latency) as Max_Latency_ms dc(pod) as Affected_Pods latest(_time) as Last_Failure by code ep | convert ctime(Last_Failure) | sort -Failures

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_api$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,body,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host), container=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name',container_name), ep=coalesce(URL,url,uri,path,request_uri,requestPath,endpoint,route,'message.URL','message.url','message.uri','message.path','message.endpoint'), code=coalesce(statusCode,status_code,http_status,httpStatus,responseCode,'message.statusCode','message.httpStatus'), method=upper(coalesce(method,httpMethod,requestMethod,'message.method','message.httpMethod')), correlation=coalesce(correlationId,correlation_id,traceId,trace_id,requestId,request_id,'message.correlationId','message.traceId','message.requestId') | rex field=txt "(?i)(?<code2>4[0-9]{2}|5[0-9]{2})" | rex field=txt "(?i)(?<ep2>https?://[^\s\"']+|/(?:api|rest|v[0-9])[^\s\"']+)" | eval code=coalesce(code,code2), ep=coalesce(ep,ep2,"Endpoint not logged"), ep=replace(ep,"\\?.*$","?[REDACTED]"), endpoint_filter="$api_endpoint$" | where tonumber(code)>=400 AND (endpoint_filter="*" OR ep=endpoint_filter) | eval txt=replace(txt,"(?i)Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/-]+=*","Bearer [REDACTED]") | table _time code method ep pod container correlation txt | sort 0 -_time | head 5000

html.p: Tracks producer/consumer activity, topics, partitions, offsets, chunk or batch identifiers, processing duration, retries, failures, and possible stuck work. Field extraction is intentionally flexible because applications log Kafka differently.

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") (kafka OR topic OR consumer OR producer OR partition OR offset) | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_kafka$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), topic=coalesce(topic,topicName,kafka_topic,'message.topic','message.topicName','message.kafka.topic') | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:topic|topicName)[=: ]+[\"']?(?<topic2>[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)" | eval topic=coalesce(topic,topic2) | where isnotnull(topic) | stats count by topic | sort -count | head 100

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") (kafka OR consumer OR producer OR chunk OR batch OR message) | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_kafka$ | where gate=1 | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw) | search (failed OR error OR exception OR retry OR dead-letter OR DLQ OR timeout) | stats count

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") (chunk OR batch OR kafka OR consumer) | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_kafka$ | where gate=1 | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw) | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:chunk|batch)[_-]?(?:id)?[=: ]+[\"']?(?<chunk_id>[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+)" | eval state=case(match(txt,"(?i)complete|completed|success|processed|committed"),"COMPLETED",match(txt,"(?i)fail|error|exception|dead-letter"),"FAILED",match(txt,"(?i)start|received|processing|consum"),"PROCESSING",true(),"OTHER") | stats earliest(_time) as Started latest(_time) as Last_Update values(state) as States by chunk_id | where isnotnull(chunk_id) AND mvfind(States,"PROCESSING")>=-1 AND mvfind(States,"COMPLETED")=-1 AND now()-Last_Update>tonumber("$stuck_threshold_seconds$") | stats count

index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") (lag OR offset OR consumer) | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_kafka$ | where gate=1 | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), lag=coalesce(consumer_lag,consumerLag,lag,'message.consumerLag','message.lag') | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:consumer[ _-]?lag|lag)[=: ]+(?<lag2>[0-9]+)" | eval lag=tonumber(coalesce(lag,lag2)) | where lag>0 | stats count

table.title: Kafka Processing State by Pod / Topic

search.query: index="$selected_index$" (kubernetes.namespace_name="$selected_project$" OR namespace="$selected_project$" OR project="$selected_project$") (kafka OR consumer OR producer OR topic OR partition OR offset OR chunk OR batch) | spath | eval dc=upper(coalesce(datacenter,data_center,region,cluster_name,'kubernetes.labels.datacenter','kubernetes.labels.region')) | eval ns_for_dc=lower(coalesce('kubernetes.namespace_name',namespace,project,"")) | eval dc=case(isnotnull(dc),dc,match(ns_for_dc,"man"),"MAN",match(ns_for_dc,"gar"),"GAR",match(ns_for_dc,"str"),"STR",match(ns_for_dc,"lew"),"LEW",true(),"UNKNOWN") | where "$datacenter$"="*" OR dc=upper("$datacenter$") | eval gate=$view_gate_kafka$ | where gate=1 | spath | eval txt=coalesce(message,_raw), pod=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name',pod_name,host), topic=coalesce(topic,topicName,kafka_topic,'message.topic','message.topicName'), partition=coalesce(partition,partitionId,'message.partition'), offset=coalesce(offset,currentOffset,'message.offset'), lag=coalesce(consumer_lag,consumerLag,lag,'message.consumerLag'), topic_filter="$kafka_topic$" | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:topic|topicName)[=: ]+[\"']?(?<topic2>[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)" | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:partition)[=: ]+(?<partition2>[0-9]+)" | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:offset)[=: ]+(?<offset2>[0-9]+)" | rex field=txt "(?i)(?:consumer[ _-]?lag|lag)[=: ]+(?<lag2>[0-9]+)" | eval topic=coalesce(topic,topic2,"Unknown"), partition=coalesce(partition,partition2,"N/A"), offset=coalesce(offset,offset2,"N/A"), lag=tonumber(coalesce(lag,lag2,0)), state=case(match(txt,"(?i)dead-letter|DLQ|failed|exception|error"),"FAILED",match(txt,"(?i)retry|rebalance|timeout"),"DEGRADED",match(txt,"(?i)complete|committed|processed|success"),"COMPLETED",match(txt,"(?i)start|received|processing|consum|produc"),"PROCESSING",true(),"OBSERVED") | where topic_filter="*" OR topic=topic_filter | stats latest(_time) as Last_Event max(lag) as Max_Lag values(state) as States latest(offset) as Latest_Offset count as Events by pod topic partition | eval Health=case(mvfind(States,"FAILED")>=-1,"RED — Failure",Max_Lag>tonumber("$lag_critical$"),"RED — High lag",mvfind(States,"DEGRADED")>=-1 OR Max_Lag>0,"AMBER — Check",true(),"GREEN — Processing") | convert ctime(Last_Event) | sort Health -Max_Lag

html.div:
L1 action guide: Confirm time, application and data center → review blast radius → capture pod/topic/endpoint and correlation/chunk ID → inspect the transaction timeline → verify whether processing recovered → use only an approved runbook. Escalate with the generated evidence table.
Safety: Log-derived status is not the same as live OCP or Kafka broker health. Confirm runtime state before restarting, scaling or replaying messages.
